# S2 interface note: remaining regions and islands

Owner: Opus 5.5 high, branch `t3/a50e5f9f` (from `c893146` + S1 `393030a`). Brief: [STREAMS § S2](../STREAMS.md#s2--remaining-regions-and-islands).

**Status: early publication of the site list.** The IDs below are stable from this commit; S4 and S5 can map onto them now. The rest of this note is completed at handoff.

## Data, all in `src/content/regions/`
- `sites.ts`: `SITES`, every authored place. Non-source sites are `<area>.<name>`; sources use registry `SourceId` style so the coordinator can lift them into `SOURCES` unchanged. Roles: source, landmark, refuge, mooring, story, entrance, volume.
- `hazards.ts`: `HAZARDS`, conservative boxes with `kind`, `protection` (thermal / chemical / none), an observable `cue` and optional `cycle`.
- `passages.ts`: `ROUTES`, keel centre lines with `carrier`, `minHalfWidth`, craft profile and access tier; `ACCESS_TIERS`; `CRAFT_PROFILES`.
- `rescue.ts`: `RESCUE_PLANS`, surface stages, pod-to-stage surface swims and Bobbin tether branches.
- `structures.ts`: `STRUCTURES`, which produce both collision solids and art dimensions.
- `layout.ts`: `worldLayout()`, an S1 `WorldLayout` for all 7 regions and 224 chunks. `spatial.ts`: `spatialEntries()`, S1 `SpatialEntry` records.
- `terrain.ts` / `worldFloor.ts`: the one shared floor.
